sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "txns" ("dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_paise" > 0), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "merchant" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "tag" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dedupe_key" TEXT NULL, "payee_is_person" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("payee_is_person" IN (0, 1)), "combined_into" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER txns_stamp_forward AFTER UPDATE OF updated_at ON txns WHEN NEW.dirty = 1 AND NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at BEGIN UPDATE txns SET updated_at = OLD.updated_at + 1 WHERE id = NEW.id;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "budget_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_paise" > 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER budgets_stamp_forward AFTER UPDATE OF updated_at ON budgets WHEN NEW.dirty = 1 AND NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at BEGIN UPDATE budgets SET updated_at = OLD.updated_at + 1 WHERE id = NEW.id;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("target_paise" > 0), "deadline" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER goals_stamp_forward AFTER UPDATE OF updated_at ON goals WHEN NEW.dirty = 1 AND NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at BEGIN UPDATE goals SET updated_at = OLD.updated_at + 1 WHERE id = NEW.id;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goal_deposits" ("dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(NOT ("amount_paise" = 0)), "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER goal_deposits_stamp_forward AFTER UPDATE OF updated_at ON goal_deposits WHEN NEW.dirty = 1 AND NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at BEGIN UPDATE goal_deposits SET updated_at = OLD.updated_at + 1 WHERE id = NEW.id;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tag_rules" ("dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "rule_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "tag" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER tag_rules_stamp_forward AFTER UPDATE OF updated_at ON tag_rules WHEN NEW.dirty = 1 AND NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at BEGIN UPDATE tag_rules SET updated_at = OLD.updated_at + 1 WHERE id = NEW.id;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "autopays" ("dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "every" TEXT NOT NULL, "next_on" INTEGER NULL, "last_paid_on" INTEGER NULL, "paused" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("paused" IN (0, 1)), "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "from_message" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("from_message" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER autopays_stamp_forward AFTER UPDATE OF updated_at ON autopays WHEN NEW.dirty = 1 AND NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at BEGIN UPDATE autopays SET updated_at = OLD.updated_at + 1 WHERE id = NEW.id;END
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "prefs" ("dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("name"));

CREATE TRIGGER prefs_stamp_forward AFTER UPDATE OF updated_at ON prefs WHEN NEW.dirty = 1 AND NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at BEGIN UPDATE prefs SET updated_at = OLD.updated_at + 1 WHERE name = NEW.name;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "insights" ("month" TEXT NOT NULL, "input_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_keys" TEXT NOT NULL, "answer" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("month"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chat_messages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goal_plans" ("goal_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "month" TEXT NOT NULL, "input_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_keys" TEXT NOT NULL, "answer" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("goal_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_cursors" ("kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "account" TEXT NOT NULL, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("kind"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_captures" ("dedupe_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "app" TEXT NOT NULL, "sender" TEXT NULL, "saved_as" TEXT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "payee" TEXT NULL, "payee_is_person" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("payee_is_person" IN (0, 1)), "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "suggested_category_id" TEXT NULL, "preview" TEXT NOT NULL, "preview_spans" TEXT NOT NULL, "lookalike" TEXT NULL, "captured_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "skipped_at" INTEGER NULL, "wallet_handle" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("dedupe_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "upcoming_payments" ("dedupe_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payee" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "due_on" INTEGER NOT NULL, "read_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "dismissed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("dedupe_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "own_moves" ("message_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "side" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "wallet_handle" TEXT NULL, "paired_with" TEXT NULL, "removed_entry" TEXT NULL, "read_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("message_key"));

CREATE INDEX chat_messages_created_at ON chat_messages (created_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX budgets_budget_key ON budgets (budget_key) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
